title: A moment of love
text: I will never forget those moments sitting across from you at that seafood boil, and the kiss we shared as we said goodbye.

title: Cooper's Birthday
text: The number 16 has always had meaning, but now it means so much more.

title: Christmas
text: One of my favourtite times of the year, and the only thing I am wishing for, is that I can spend it with you.

title: Kayla's Birthday
text: When you finally get to take off those Green P's today is all about you, and I cant wait to celebrate it with you.

title: Beverly
text: sitting across from you and seeing the sunset over your shoulder is a memory that I will not ever forget, and I am so happy to have shared such a beautiful night with you. from the Oysters to the cocktails, and massages back home, every second with you was a dream come true.
